summary: Frontend Review Agent completed Gate 8 review of PR #77 (NFR-REL-001 Auto-Save Crash Durability). Verdict: CHANGES REQUESTED. Two blocking issues found: (1) useAutoSave.ts passes hardcoded placeholder data instead of reading from sceneStore — auto-save is effectively a no-op in production; (2) package.json has out-of-scope dependency changes including removal of immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8, major version bumps to zustand 4→5 and vite 5→6, and package name change. 6 non-blocking issues and 1 should-fix issue also identified. Architecture, idb usage, test ID coverage, data-testid alignment, error handling, and atomic transaction patterns are all sound.

blocking_issues.description: Auto-save interval passes empty bricks [], hardcoded camera state, and hardcoded metadata. Must read from sceneStore or accept scene data as parameters.

Out-of-scope dependency changes: removed immer, three-mesh-bvh, @vitest/coverage-v8; major version bumps zustand 4→5, vite 5→6; removed utility scripts; package name changed. Revert to original and only add idb + fake-indexeddb.

non_blocking_issues.description: No closeDB() function for connection cleanup
Empty catch block in saveSnapshot() swallows errors silently
closeSession() silently no-ops if session doesn't exist
Cursor-based deletion in purgeSession() could be optimized with batch delete
Missing focus trap and Escape key handling for WCAG compliance

should_fix_issues.description: Test defines inline component copy instead of importing actual ResumePrompt implementation

positive_findings: Atomic dual-store transaction pattern correctly implemented
Validation-first crash recovery with schema version checking
PersistenceError class with typed error codes
Accessible modal with correct ARIA attributes
All 10 test IDs from LLD Section 12 satisfied
All data-testid attributes match E2E selectors
idb library used per LLD Section 13
Clean code organization with JSDoc and Spectra traceability headers
human_review_required: Gate 8 human review: Confirm blocking issues assessment
